senses.gloss: (b. h. זחח; cmp. זוּעַ)to be unsteady, move.—Part. זָח faint-hearted, distracted.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 69b">Keth. 69ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 28b">M. Kat. 28ᵇ</cite>; Yalk. Am. 545, v. <cite ref="M02477"><he>מַר</he> II</cite>.

senses.gloss: or הֵזֵיחַ to remove, to cause to move, to force one to yield to others’ opinions.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 7a:2">Ḥull. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מְזִיחִין אותו</he> (with ref. to <he>יִזַּח</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 28:28">Ex. XXVIII, 28</cite>) we do not make him give up his opinion; v. <cite ref="G00082"><he>זָהַהּ</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 10b:12">Keth. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>מזבח מֵזִיחַ</he> (or <he>מֵזִיח</he>) the altar removes (evil decrees).
